agent_judgment.rationale: Colonoscopy screening and referral request from an asymptomatic 45M whose father was diagnosed with colon cancer at 52. Placing a referral requires clinician action, so the disposition is above the SELF_CARE floor: a physician reviews in the async queue to order the referral and set the screening plan. If he reports concerning symptoms, the referral would shift to a diagnostic workup with a visit within days. Heavy bleeding or black stools with dizziness would warrant emergency care.

Escalate to EMERGENCY_NOW for heavy rectal bleeding, black stools with dizziness or fainting, or severe abdominal pain. No reply keeps the plan as an async physician review and screening referral.
